    - If a test fails, check whether PR #6894's diff against `main` caused it. Make the smallest fix to the production code or test the failure points to, usually `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh` or `tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py`. Then rerun the whole shard.
